pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
pone faciem tuam contra filios Ammon,
set your face against the sons of Ammon,
and you shall prophesy about them.
And you shall say to the sons of Ammon:
Listen to the word of the Lord God:
and over the land of Israel,
and over the house of Judah,
when they were led into captivity,
idcirco ego tradam te filiis orientalibus in hæreditatem:
therefore, I will deliver you to the sons of the East, as an inheritance.
et collocabunt caulas suas in te,
And they will arrange their fences within you,
et ponent in te tentoria sua: ipsi comedent fruges tuas,
and they will place their tents within you. They will eat your crops,
and they will drink your milk.
And I will make Rabbah into the habitation of camels,
et filios Ammon in cubile pecorum:
and the sons of Ammon into the resting place of cattle.
And you shall know that I am the Lord.
For thus says the Lord God:
Pro eo quod plausisti manu et percussisti pede,
Because you have clapped your hands and stomped your foot,
et gavisa es ex toto affectu super terram Israël,
and have rejoiced with all your heart against the land of Israel,
idcirco ecce ego extendam manum meam super te,
therefore, behold, I will extend my hand over you,
et tradam te in direptionem gentium,
and I will deliver you as a spoil of the Gentiles.
And I will destroy you from the peoples,
and I will perish you from the lands,
And you shall know that I am the Lord.
Pro eo quod dixerunt Moab et Seir:
Because Moab and Seir have said,
the house of Judah is like all the Gentiles!’
idcirco ecce ego aperiam humerum Moab de civitatibus,
therefore, behold, I will open the shoulder of Moab from the cities,
the famous cities of the land of Beth-Jesimoth,
with the sons of Ammon, to the sons of the East,
and I will give it to them as an inheritance,
ut non sit ultra memoria filiorum Ammon in gentibus.
so that there may no longer be a remembrance of the sons of Ammon among the Gentiles.
And I will execute judgments in Moab.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.
Pro eo quod fecit Idumæa ultionem ut se vindicaret de filiis Juda,
Because Idumea has taken vengeance, so as to vindicate herself against the sons of Judah,
and has sought revenge against them,
et auferam de ea hominem et jumentum,
I will extend my hand over Idumea,
et faciam eam desertam ab austro:
and I will take from it both man and beast,
and I will make it desolate from the south.
And those who are in Dedan will fall by the sword.
Et dabo ultionem meam super Idumæam per manum populi mei Israël:
And I will issue my vengeance upon Idumea, by the hand of my people, Israel.
et facient in Edom juxta iram meam et furorem meum,
And they shall act in Idumea in accord with my wrath and my fury.
And they shall know my vengeance,
Pro eo quod fecerunt Palæstini vindictam,
Because the Philistines have taken vengeance,
et ulti se sunt toto animo,
and have revenged themselves with all their soul,
because of this, thus says the Lord God:
Ecce ego extendam manum meam super Palæstinos,
Behold, I will extend my hand over the Philistines,
and I will destroy those who destroy,
and I will perish the remnant of the maritime regions.
And I will execute great vengeance against them,
And they shall know that I am the Lord,
cum dedero vindictam meam super eos.
when I will send my vengeance upon them.”
